message.content: {"caption":"Two-panel line chart comparing Solve and Propose reward and token length across training steps for the induction task.","description":"The target is a two-panel line chart. Both panels use Training Steps on the horizontal axis, with ticks at 0, 40, 80, 120, 160, 200, 240, and 280. The legend identifies Solve with a purple line and Propose with a salmon line. The left panel plots Reward on a 0–0.7 vertical scale and is labeled “Induction Task.” Solve rises from near zero to about 0.55 by step 80, stays mostly around 0.5–0.55 through about step 200, then fluctuates downward and ends near 0.45. Propose rises more gradually, mostly remains below Solve, has a brief peak near step 115, and climbs toward about 0.30 at the end. The right panel plots Token Length against the same steps, using the right-hand vertical axis, which runs from 250 to 2000. Solve fluctuates at lower lengths early, spikes sharply to roughly 1,750 near step 110, falls back to around 700–800, and rises again late to roughly 1,300. Propose has an early spike around step 60 and another near step 115, then is comparatively steady and trends gradually lower, ending near 600. The plotted lines have no point labels; chart values below are estimated read-offs at the x-axis
